detailed_sections.heading: Design & Measured Fundamentals
detailed_sections.content: On the bench, the Marmot Limestone 4-Person Camping Tent measures 4800g. Zone pre-bend construction creates vertical walls and roomy sleeping area with heavy-duty weatherproofing. Fit and finish match what we expect at this price bracket.

detailed_sections.heading: Lab Protocol & Measured Results
detailed_sections.content: Withstood 4-hour severe torrential downpour simulation with zero interior moisture accumulation. Pitch timing averaged 6.5 minutes across three timed trials.

detailed_sections.heading: Who Should Buy It
detailed_sections.content: This model suits beginners, winter snow, heavy load, easy setup, long distance. Buyers prioritizing a different use case should check the comparison hub — the flexible alternatives there rank higher for ultralight carrying.

faqs.question: Is the Marmot 4-Person Camping Tent true to size / spec?
faqs.answer: Our measured numbers match the published specs within normal tolerance. If you wear thick hiking socks or run between sizes, order accordingly.

faqs.question: How does it handle sustained bad weather?
faqs.answer: In our hydrostatic protocol the 68D Polyester Ripstop 1500mm / 70D floor 2000mm showed zero ingress. For multi-day storms, re-treat seams seasonally.

faqs.question: What is the return policy when buying through Amazon?
faqs.answer: Purchases through the official Amazon listing include the standard 30-day return window — test it at home under real conditions first.
